models.name: Entity resolution
models.target: Whether two records refer to the same legal entity.
models.pit_feature_rule: Use only identifiers and names known at the record's known_at.
models.baseline: Exact match on registry ID, then normalized-name match.
models.validation: Labelled pairs with precision and recall per language and script.
models.failure_modes: Transliteration collisions; shared names; merging subsidiaries into parents.

models.name: Round-progression survival model
models.target: Time to the next qualifying round, with exit and failure as competing events.
models.pit_feature_rule: Features as of cohort formation date; no later-announced rounds.
models.failure_modes: Survivorship and reporting lag; censoring of quiet companies treated as failures.

models.name: Technology-emergence detection
models.target: Growth in a technology domain across patents, papers, code, and grants.
models.pit_feature_rule: Counts by publication or grant date, not filing date.
models.validation: Retrospective detection of known past emergences with lead time reported.

models.name: Network and link analysis
models.target: Likelihood of co-investment or ownership links between organizations.
models.pit_feature_rule: Edges with known_at before the prediction date.
models.failure_modes: Hub bias; privacy drift toward individuals; no person-level profiling.

models.name: Funding-flow anomaly detection
models.target: Unusual funding patterns by investor, sector, or jurisdiction.
models.pit_feature_rule: Rolling windows of announced rounds as known.
models.failure_modes: Reporting lag looks like a drop; seasonality; indicator is not a finding.

models.name: Sector-funding nowcast
models.target: Current-quarter funding before databases fill in.
models.pit_feature_rule: Only data with known_at before the nowcast date.
models.validation: Real-time vintages compared with final data.
models.failure_modes: Revisions; structural breaks; incomplete recent data.

models.name: Fund-outcome simulation
models.target: Distribution of fund multiples under power-law outcomes and reserve policy.
models.pit_feature_rule: Inputs fixed at a stated date; parameters from disclosed cohorts.
models.baseline: Equal-outcome null and bootstrap from cohort.
models.validation: Interval estimates and null comparison; sensitivity to tail parameters.
models.failure_modes: Small samples; tail-dominated results; false precision.
